LanguageData.GW40K_TheSorrow_DysphorakhDesc:
The Sorrow left a scar in {PAWN_nameDef}'s neural engrams. Surfacing from Soul-Debt immersion, the mind carried phantom-biological sensations it could not shed — and now cannot stop generating.

{PAWN_nameDef} has developed Dysphorakh: the cascading phantom-biological condition unique to Necrons who could not fully suppress the memory of what they once were. Expect recurring episodes of phantom suffocation, starvation, and sensory horror.

In the most severe cases, Dysphorakh is the first step toward the Flaying Curse.
LanguageData.GW40K_Dysphorakh_Suffocation: {PAWN_nameDef} is seized by phantom suffocation — drowning in lungs that no longer exist.
LanguageData.GW40K_Dysphorakh_PhantomHunger: {PAWN_nameDef} is wracked by phantom hunger — desperately seeking food for a stomach the living metal cannot provide.
LanguageData.GW40K_Dysphorakh_SensoryDisconnect: {PAWN_nameDef} has entered sensory disconnect — buried alive in a sarcophagus with no skin, no heartbeat, no warmth.
LanguageData.GW40K_Dysphorakh_Clawing: {PAWN_nameDef} has begun tearing at their own frame — compulsively clawing to clear obstructions that are not there. Intervene before the Flaying Curse takes hold.
LanguageData.GW40K_Dysphorakh_Clawing_Stage2: {PAWN_nameDef}'s clawing has intensified to mid-stage. The Flaying Curse is strengthening. Intervention is becoming critical.
LanguageData.GW40K_Dysphorakh_Clawing_Stage3: {PAWN_nameDef}'s clawing has reached critical intensity — the Flaying Curse can no longer be talked down. Only downing the pawn can stop it. A Flayed One may be imminent.
LanguageData.GW40K_Dysphorakh_FlayedConversion: {PAWN_nameDef} has succumbed to the Flaying Curse. The Necron is no more — only a Flayed One remains. The rage will pass; after that, they can be brought under command.
